d:
Allah Hoo by Kanwar Grewal and Kaur B is out now With music by Desi Crew, two of the most distinctive voices in Punjabi music come together on a track rooted in sufi tradition.
Kanwar Grewal brings the devotional weight he's known for, Kaur B answers it, and Desi Crew hold the whole thing together. Out now on Speed Records.
Song Credits
Song - Allah Hoo
Singer - Kanwar Grewal - Kaur B
Music - Desi Crew
Label - Speed Records
